operation: Continuous one-metre approach, window push and sensor-confirmed recovery after late contact loss if needed
scope: Development attempt, not complete interstation experiment or repeated-run qualification

recovery.trigger: Push contact loss only: filtered load below 0.1 N for more than 0.35 s, commanded travel at least 60 mm; no overload recovery
recovery.outcome: Original 8 distinct fresh native RGB-D fits, 66--74 mm interior guard, stable observed position, followed by settled return; fault retained until completion
recovery.unchanged_limits: 6 N load guard; all original physical review contact, support, travel, joint and motor thresholds
recovery.retained_evidence: Original recovery fault and its context remain in events; failed attempt 07 is unchanged
recovery.source_of_decisions: Native tactile, RGB-D, encoders and IMU only; reviewer truth is not supplied to the actor
